lines.t: Stone and steel, this world's on fire
Voices tell us less of saviors for hire
But when the lies burn out, there's still one flame
Piercing through the smoke, I hear your name
You came down, walked our broken ground
Heaven in a heartbeat, wearing thorn and crown
Nails and blood the innocent condemn
Yet death fell silent when you rose again
I have tasted all this earth can give
Still my starving soul cries out
There is none like You, Lord Yahushua No other name can break these chains
There is none like You, Lord Yahushua Every throne falls down before Your reign
Holy, holy, all creation sings
There is none like you, my God
Drafted as the thunder of a holy one
Lion of Yehudah, David's greater son
You wore our shame, but never wore our sin
Perfect lamb of glory, spotless
From with every idol that I raised up high
Crumbled when your mercy opened up my eyes
Who am I that you would call my name?
Dust and breath held fast by endless grave
I was buried under weight of night
Till your wounded hands pulled me to the light
There is none like you, Lord, yeah, who's sure
No other name can break these chains
There is none like You, Lord Yahushua
Every throne falls down before Your reign
Holy, holy, all creation sings
There is none like You, my God, my King
No angel, no power, no wisdom of man
No empire, no darkness can stand
Against the one who spoke and worlds began
First and last, the great I am
In the hurt, in the roaring sea
In the fire, you are all I see
Heaven's song, ever strong and true
All my heart bows down to you
There is no life like you, Lord Yahushua
Name above every earthly name
There is no life like you, Lord Yahushua
Oh, forever singing of your fame
Holy, holy
All creation sings
There is none like you
My God, my King
